SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.550676, -82.634411 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTED THAT DURING OFFLOADING OF A STRONG NITRIC ACID TANKER TRUCK, THERE WAS AN AS OF YET UNIDENTIFIED EQUIPMENT FAILURE. TOTAL AMOUNT RELEASED IS 4915 POUNDS OF NITRIC ACID. SOME MATERIAL WENT INTO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT AND APPROXIMATELY 1966 POUNDS ESCAPED SECONDARY CONTAINMENT AND IMPACTED CONCRETE, ASPHALT, AND POSSIBLY AN ON-SITE STORM CONVEYANCE (ROAD SIDE DITCH). CALLER ALSO BELIEVES THAT DUE TO THE RELEASE OF NITRIC ACID THAT THEY HAVE EXCEEDED THE RQ FOR NOX (10 POUNDS) BUT THE TOTAL AMOUNT RELEASED IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN. CALLER DOES NOT BELIEVE THAT ANY MATERIAL HAS LEFT THE SITE. 4 INDIVIDUALS WERE CHECKED OUT ONSITE FOR POTENTIAL INJURIES, AND 10 EMPLOYEES WERE EVACUATED FROM THE IMMEDIATE AREA OF THE SPILL ON-SITE.

CALLER STATED AN ENCLOSED SO2 SCRUBBER OVERFLOWED INTO A CONTAINMENT DIKE DUE TO MECHANICAL FAILURE. LIQUID LEAKED THROUGH A CONCRETE JOINT BETWEEN THE BASE OF THE DIKE AND THE WALL OF THE DIKE.
